newsitem.title: USA: Multicanal files for 9.2 million ADS in IPO.
newsitem.headline: Multicanal files for 9.2 million ADS in IPO.

text.p: Multicanal Participacoes S.A. said Tuesday it filed a registration statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to 9,230,769 American Depositary Shares (ADS) in its initial public offering.

The Brazilian company, engaged in the cable television industry, said of the amount, 6,923,077 ADS will be sold in the United States and 2,307,692 ADS will be sold outside the United States, Canada and Brazil.
The offering is estimated to be priced between $12 and $14 per ADS share, the filing said.

The offering will be made through Morgan Stanley & Co Inc, Merrill Lynch & Co and Lazard Freres and Co Inc. The selling stockholders have granted the underwrites an over-allotment option of up to 1,730,769 additional ADS.

The net proceeds are estimated at about US$95 million and will be used to fund extension of the company's cable network buildout in its existing licensed service areas and upgrade the cable network architecture in three other cable systems.
The remainder of the proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes.
The company, known in english as Multicanal Holdings Inc, has applied for listing on Nasdaq under the symbol "MPAR".
